query:
WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO offer (id, user_id, slug, title, description, price, currency, idempotency_key, category)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id, user_id, slug, title, description, price, currency, category, image_count, created_at, updated_at, true AS is_new
        )
        SELECT 
            id AS "id!", 
            user_id AS "user_id!", 
            slug AS "slug!", 
            title AS "title!", 
            description AS "description!", 
            price AS "price!", 
            currency AS "currency!",
            category AS "category!",
            image_count AS "image_count!", 
            created_at AS "created_at!", 
            updated_at AS "updated_at!", 
            is_new AS "is_new!"
        FROM inserted
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            id, 
            user_id, 
            slug, 
            title, 
            description, 
            price, 
            currency, 
            category,
            image_count, 
            created_at, 
            updated_at, 
            false AS is_new
        FROM offer
        WHERE user_id = $2 AND idempotency_key = $8
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
